fact: The Ministry of Finance's Fiscal Decentralisation Policy and Implementation Strategy (2025-2029), carrying the memo reference CP (2025)2 of 22 January 2025, commits in its foreword to enhancing financial management capacity among local authorities "through the introduction of real time processing IFMIS system (PFM Smart)"; it names the system the councils are to work in and says nothing of how their offices are connected or of a cost for it.
title: Fiscal Decentralisation Policy & Implementation Strategy (2025-2029)
publisher: Fiscal Decentralisation Department, Ministry of Finance, Sierra Leone
